data.name: Daaem
data.gender_notes: Daaem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Daaem is derived from the Arabic root word 'd-m-m', which means 'firm, steadfast, constant, and persistent'. In Islamic context, it can be interpreted as one who is steadfast in faith, unwavering in belief, and committed to righteousness. The name Daaem carries the meaning “Firm, Constant, Persistent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daaem usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, constant, persistent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daaem total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
